title: Aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#c8dcf0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wing' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#e8f2ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#9fc0e0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- shadow / sky glow under plane -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#2a4a6a' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M18 46 L10 22 L22 22 L30 44 Z' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <path d='M18 46 L10 22 L16 22 L22 44 Z' fill='#ff9d9d'/>
  <!-- horizontal tail -->
  <path d='M24 46 L8 48 L12 54 L28 52 Z' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- main wing (far) -->
  <path d='M46 50 L74 30 L86 34 L54 56 Z' fill='#8fb0d0'/>
  <!-- main wing (near) -->
  <path d='M44 54 L70 68 L82 62 L52 46 Z' fill='url(#wing)'/>
  <path d='M44 54 L70 68 L72 64 L48 52 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- fuselage -->
  <path d='M20 50 Q20 40 32 40 L72 40 Q92 42 92 50 Q92 58 72 60 L32 60 Q20 60 20 50 Z' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <!-- lower shading of fuselage -->
  <path d='M22 54 Q24 59 34 59 L72 59 Q88 57 90 52 Q80 58 60 58 L34 58 Q26 58 22 54 Z' fill='#9fc0e0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- cockpit windows -->
  <path d='M70 43 Q78 42 82 45 Q78 47 70 47 Z' fill='#3ec8ff'/>
  <path d='M62 44 Q66 43 68 45 Q66 47 62 47 Z' fill='#3ec8ff'/>
  <!-- windows along body -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='50' r='2.2' fill='#3ec8ff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='50' r='2.2' fill='#3ec8ff'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='50' r='2.2' fill='#3ec8ff'/>
  <!-- nose highlight -->
  <path d='M84 46 Q90 47 91 50 Q89 47 84 46 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- engine under wing -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='60' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='59' rx='5' ry='2.6' fill='#fff3c4'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='60' r='3.2' fill='#e0a832'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='60' r='2' fill='#fff3c4'/>
  <!-- stripe on fuselage -->
  <path d='M30 55 L74 55 Q86 55 88 51 Q74 57 56 57 L32 57 Q28 57 26 55 Z' fill='#ff6b6b' opacity='0.85'/>
</svg>
